documentation.file_docstring:
Tests for Anthropic, Gemini, and Mistral governance adapters.

All tests use mocks — no real API calls are made.
inline_comments: Ensure optional SDK imports don't block test collection.  We mock the
third-party libraries so tests run without installing them.
member_docstrings: TestAnthropicKernel: Tests for the Anthropic Claude governance adapter.
TestGeminiKernel: Tests for the Google Gemini governance adapter.
TestMistralKernel: Tests for the Mistral AI governance adapter.
test_wrap_and_unwrap: wrap() returns a governed client; unwrap() returns the original.
test_messages_create_happy_path: A normal messages.create call should succeed and track tokens.
test_blocked_pattern_rejects_message: Messages matching blocked patterns should be rejected.
test_max_tokens_policy_enforcement: Requesting more tokens than the policy allows should fail.
test_cumulative_token_limit: Exceeding the cumulative token limit should raise.
test_tool_call_validation: Tool use blocks with disallowed tools should be rejected.
test_tool_definition_validation: Passing disallowed tool definitions should be rejected.
